answer: Require every identity to climb an audit spiral before it earns: a new agent draws rewards only after auditing other agents' work, and those audits are spot-checked by established agents. Picture the network as an orchard where each tree's fruit is inspected before it counts. Joining locks a copper bond; an audit caught rubber-stamping fake work slashes the bond and prunes the identity. A Sybil farmer must therefore pay audit labor plus a bond per fake, and since fakes audit each other, one exposed audit betrays the whole ring — cost scales with every fake, while an honest agent pays once.
